verdict.summary: A multi-tenant Xero agent can use a confidential web-server OAuth app and end-user OAuth, but the normal Accounting scopes an agent needs are subject to certification. Start on the free Starter tier for a five-connection beta, then move through Core and Plus for certification; do not promise an approval date because Xero publishes no general certification SLA. Advanced/Enterprise adds an initial and annual security assessment.
verdict.activeEffort: 2–4 days (estimate), mostly building secure OAuth, connection-management UX, certification evidence, and accounting-action safeguards
verdict.waitTime: Unknown: no official or community figure found
verdict.mainGate: Certification for normal Accounting-scope production growth; Xero indicates ten active customer connections and other prerequisites may be checked.

recommendation.text: Build a confidential web-server app using the Auth Code grant, with one encrypted token set and explicit authorised Xero tenant connection per customer workspace. Use granular read scopes first and request write scopes only after a user explicitly initiates an accounting action; Custom Connections are unsuitable because they support only one organisation.

sources.quote: Web server apps that can securely store a client secret.
Custom Connections can only ever connect to a single organisation.
You should request the minimum scopes required for whatever action that user is performing.
From there, you can make API calls by providing both a valid access token and authorized tenant id with each request.

essentials.text: Request offline_access for persistent connections. Access tokens are valid for up to 30 minutes and refresh tokens for up to 60 days; every refresh rotates the refresh token, so atomically store both returned tokens and expiry timestamps and serialize refreshes per connection. An old refresh token has a 30-minute retry grace period after a failed response, after which the user must reconnect.

sources.quote: They are only valid for up to 30 minutes
These are valid for up to 60 days.
Every time you use a `refresh_token`, you will get a new one along with the new `access_token`.
Only allow **one thread** to refresh the token at a time.

essentials.text: Register exact absolute callback URLs in My Apps; wildcards are prohibited and an app can have up to 50 redirect URIs. Use HTTPS in production; http://localhost/ is allowed for testing, but http://127.0.0.1 is rejected.

sources.quote: The OAuth 2.0 spec (section 3.1.2 of RFC 6749) requires that a redirection URI must be an absolute URI. The use of wildcards in redirect URI is not supported.
You can use up to 50 redirect URIs for your app.
This must be an https address, however for testing you can use http://localhost/ Please note that http://127.0.0.1 cannot be used

essentials.text: Use a free Xero account and its Demo Company for development. New apps start on Starter with five connections; each Xero organisation or practice may connect at most five uncertified apps.

sources.quote: Signup for a free Xero account
Enable the Xero demo company
New apps default to the starter tier with 5 connections.
Additionally, each organisation or practice is limited to connecting a maximum of five uncertified apps.

essentials.text: Throttle by tenant to five concurrent calls and 60 calls per minute, budget daily calls by plan, and honor HTTP 429 responses and Retry-After. The app-wide minute limit is 10,000 calls.

sources.quote: Concurrent Limit: 5 calls in progress at one time
Minute Limit: 60 calls per minute
Daily Limit: 1,000 calls per day for starter, 5,000 calls per day for higher tiers
App Minute Limit: 10,000 calls per minute
Exceeding a rate limit will result in an HTTP 429 (too many requests) response.

essentials.text: Encrypt tokens before storage, keep them out of client-side code, publish terms explaining data use, and maintain documented industry-standard safeguards. Advanced and Enterprise additionally require an initial and annual security assessment; report relevant security incidents to Xero within 24 hours of discovery.

sources.quote: Tokens should be encrypted before they’re written to your database or cache.
Never show or store sensitive data like the access token, client id and client secret in the client side of the application
Security Assessment (initial and annual)

steps.title: Create the development account, Demo Company, and OAuth app

detail.text: In Xero Developer Centre My Apps, create an OAuth 2.0 application, select the Auth Code grant type, and retain the client secret only in server-side secret storage. Enable the Demo Company for safe integration testing.

sources.quote: Add an OAuth 2.0 application
To get started, create an OAuth2 app and make sure you select the “Auth Code” grant type.
The Client Secret is private and should not be shared.

steps.title: Register production and local callback URLs

detail.text: In the app OAuth configuration, add exact HTTPS production callback URLs and, if needed, http://localhost/ for local testing. Do not add wildcard URLs or 127.0.0.1 addresses.

sources.quote: The use of wildcards in redirect URI is not supported.
This must be an https address, however for testing you can use http://localhost/ Please note that http://127.0.0.1 cannot be used

steps.title: Draft the callback security contract

detail.text: Use this implementation contract in the server-side OAuth callback handler, then have the developer implement and deploy it with the registered redirect URI.

steps.output: Generate one-time state bound to user_id and connection_attempt_id; store a hash and expiry. On callback, require exact state match before exchanging code. POST code, redirect_uri, and grant_type=authorization_code to https://identity.xero.com/connect/token using HTTP Basic(client_id:client_secret). Store authorised tenant ID with the workspace connection, never infer it from email.

steps.title: Choose granular consent scopes and token storage

detail.text: Configure the initial authorisation request for offline_access and only the read scopes required by the first agent feature. Encrypt access and refresh tokens individually at rest, persist expiries, and implement a per-connection refresh lock with atomic replacement of rotated tokens.

sources.quote: **Web and PKCE apps** – Since March 2026, all new and existing Web and PKCE apps have been assigned granular scopes.
Don’t Store Tokens in Plaintext - even in internal databases, never store access or refresh tokens in plaintext.
Always store access_token_expires_at and refresh_token_expires_at alongside your tokens.

steps.title: Test multi-tenant consent and rotation against the Demo Company

detail.text: Connect the Demo Company, verify that the application stores the selected authorised tenant ID per workspace, exercise token refresh and reconnect handling, and load-test below the per-tenant concurrency and minute limits.

sources.quote: A user may have access to multiple tenants and will choose which ones to connect to your app.

detail.text: Add a setup page that displays the connected tenant name and connection state, offers reconnect and disconnect, deletes the tenant connection through the Connections endpoint during offboarding, and requires user review before write actions with account-code and tax-rate mapping.

sources.quote: Include a button to disconnect the integration
Use the method of DELETE from the Connections endpoint to remove a connection to a tenant.
you should allow customers to map Xero tax rates to your tax rates; or give the user the option to create them if necessary.

steps.output: Requested scopes: accounting.invoices.read and accounting.payments.read support user-requested financial summaries. Write scopes are requested only after the user confirms a create/manage action. Tokens are encrypted at rest, refreshes are serialized, and each connection is bound to an authorised tenant ID. Reviewer path: sign in, open Xero setup, connect Demo Company, verify tenant display, run read summary, disconnect.

detail.text: After the beta validates the product, add payment to move from Starter to Core as needed, then upgrade to Plus and submit certification evidence, test-account access if requested, privacy terms, connection-management UX, and action-safety controls. Do not submit broad deprecated accounting.transactions scopes for a new design.

steps.title: Operate the certified integration with AI-data controls

detail.text: Deploy tenant-aware queues, 429 backoff, encrypted token operations, disconnect handling, and incident procedures. Use Xero API Data only for the approved agent feature; do not use it to train, fine-tune, adapt, or enhance any AI model, and obtain associated-user consent before passing API Data to another third party.
